title: Reuse scoped inventory coverage in implementation decks
statement: As an Architect or Developer, I can select the code relevant to an implementation deck through its referenced Systems, Components, and data entities so the deck reuses grounded evidence without claiming the entities' entire implementations.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A deck's entity reference retains an inspectable selection of the relevant exact code subset; referencing a System does not automatically select all member Components or all of their code.
The selected subset contributes to implementation-deck coverage through the inventory reference without requiring a duplicate independent mapping of the same underlying evidence.
For inherited coverage, the report exposes the referencing deck Item, the System/Component/data-entity path, and the selected source locations that account for it.
Unselected code contributes no inherited coverage, overlapping selections count only once, and stale or unresolved paths remain visible rather than count as current coverage.
